$comment: Drain merge-queue safeguards: drain.waitForRedTeamBeforeEnqueue and drain.dequeueOnSendBack are booleans, both standard true. Inherit platform drain preferences unless deliberately overriding here. Environment overrides WE_DRAIN_WAIT_FOR_RED_TEAM_BEFORE_ENQUEUE and WE_DRAIN_DEQUEUE_ON_SEND_BACK accept true/false, 1/0, on/off. Effective values and sources are logged by both drain and red-team gate. Enqueue waits for the trusted post-accept red-team result comment on the exact live head only after a head-bound speculative or sequential red-team run is recorded as queued, running, or attempted; before the review job writes that status, a persisted accepting review run for the live head that owes a pass holds while the red team is enabled, and labels alone never schedule a pass. A queued or running status is live only while its writer is alive. Card-only net diffs are exempt while the producer skips them; a started pass remains owed. A confirmed send-back break also withholds enqueue until routed. Send-back removes queue membership, confirms isInMergeQueue=false, and comments with the reason. The red-team gate acts immediately; drain checks all live open rows before candidate filtering and its durable queue follow-ups as a backstop. Pending red-team reads retry after drain.redTeamPendingBackoffSec (standard 300 seconds), or when preread comments show a new comment. Pending state is durable and bound to the live head. After drain.redTeamPendingMaxMin (standard 45 minutes) with an owed pass, return and log a health smell naming the PR. Recheck head-bound run evidence and complete comments at the deadline even during backoff. If no usable result is recorded and no run is in flight or live in the queue, use an available review red-team request hook; without a request path, drain.enqueueWhenRedTeamNeverScheduled (standard true, env WE_DRAIN_ENQUEUE_WHEN_RED_TEAM_NEVER_SCHEDULED) permits enqueue with a loud red team never scheduled note and policy source. No standalone red-team request queue exists in the current drain host, so it uses this fallback. Recorded breaks and recorded or active runs remain held. Both positive numeric settings use the drain cascade, log their sources, and accept WE_DRAIN_RED_TEAM_PENDING_BACKOFF_SEC / WE_DRAIN_RED_TEAM_PENDING_MAX_MIN overrides. redTeam.drainReadsSavedResult (standard true; WE_RED_TEAM_DRAIN_READS_SAVED_RESULT) also accepts completed saved evidence for the exact repo/PR/live head when no trusted result comment exists; confirmed breaks use the existing gate and admission hold. Standard, platform redTeam, tool redTeam, and environment cascade sources are logged. Corrupt/incomplete saved evidence refuses admission. Applies equally to code, docs, config, and data changes; never changes scheduler obligations.
